title: Yummy Crispy Ukrainian Cabbage Casserole
description: A briny, crunchy one-pot casserole that blends tender cabbage with savory meat, coated in flaky egg roll wrappers and topped with a crisp double-rise bread crust.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F and lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a large skillet, brown the ground pork and beef mixture over medium-high heat until fully cooked, about 8 minutes.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet, cooking until the onion softens, about 4 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce, tomato paste, and dried dill, cooking for another minute until fragrant.
Transfer the meat mixture to the prepared baking dish, spreading it evenly.
Layer the shredded cabbage over the meat, pressing it down lightly so it stays in place.
Arrange the cubed double-rise bread evenly over the cabbage, then sprinkle the beaten eggs and low-fat milk on top.
Place the egg roll wrappers over the bread layer, ensuring they cover the bread entirely.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the egg roll wrappers are golden and the cabbage is tender.
Remove from the oven, let cool for 5 minutes, then serve hot.
